note: Painter's algorithm: lower z is drawn first. Every file is 1024x1024. The compositor never repositions pixels.

contact_shadow.note: Default contact shadow is drawn by the compositor from foot anchors so it cannot drift. An illustrated override may replace it later if needed.

split_assets.note: Some traits occupy more than one z-index. The generator selects ONE trait id; the compositor loads every file the trait declares.
examples: sign = rear_held (board behind) + front_held (handle and board front) + arm_pose hold-sign
fishing-not-used = rejected theme; collection stays winter-shelter
umbrella = rear_held (canopy behind head) + front_held (shaft in hand) when open
lantern = front_held only, requires arm_pose hold-item

occlusion_rules: Background is the only opaque layer.
Rear accessory is always behind the body (backpacks, bedrolls, extra tent fly).
Pattern clips to the body mask during registration, not during compositing.
Structural details (poles, zipper, seams, door trim) sit on top of pattern so they stay readable.
Legs sit under footwear. Footwear never floats above baseline_y.
Face stack is face > eyes > brows > mouth > facial. Sunglasses live in facial and require sunglasses-compatible eyes.
Front arm occludes the torso. A held mug never slides behind the body unless it is the rear_held portion of a split asset.
Headwear occludes the crown/peak and never the mouth. Brim sits at headwear_brim_y.
Atmosphere may overlay the scene but is punched out of the inflated face oval so snow cannot blind the character.
Logo is last and is not generated until Phase 10.
